tax.text: Singh's campaign platform calls for cutting taxes and fees on gas, food, and other essentials.
tax.quote: Reduce taxes and fees on gas, food, and other essential items.

housing.text: Singh proposes easing environmental regulations and fees to enable more low-cost housing.
housing.quote: Provide the same relief from environmental regulations and fees that builders of sports stadiums and other local revenue boosters receive, so that low-cost homes can be available for the poor and the homeless.

schools.text: Singh says parents should be able to move their children to another public or charter school.
schools.quote: Parents should also have the right to move their child to another public or charter school.

safety.text: Singh says police should be funded to local needs and district attorneys should prosecute criminals to deter repeat offenders.
safety.quote: Law enforcement budgets should reflect the needs of the local population, and technology should be used to reduce crime and protect what are now fearful communities and business owners.

sentencing.text: Singh calls for repealing AB 109 and Propositions 47 and 57, which reduced sentences and early-release restrictions.
sentencing.quote: AB 109, and Props. 47 and 57 have not led to safer communities and must be repealed.

immigration.text: Singh calls for repealing California's sanctuary-state status and prioritizing services for citizens over asylum seekers.
immigration.quote: Repeal California's Sanctuary State status and prioritize services for citizens over asylum seekers.
